headline: LAD @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 4.79 at ARI 2.71, with a projected total of 7.50. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAD: LAD moved +0.58 runs while ARI moved -0.24, changing the projected margin by +0.81 runs. The projected total climbed +0.34, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Shohei Ohtani has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Andy Pages, Shohei Ohtani, Freddie Freeman, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Pavin Smith because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
